## Today's learning {#ss6-objective .gs-lesson }

### Lesson objective

Understand how cancellation gives a formula for the sum of a finite geometric series.

### Success criteria

I can derive the formula, identify the first term and number of terms, and use the appropriate formula to solve problems.

::: notes


Assume fluency with function and sequence notation, the geometric general term and summation notation. No input/output recap is needed.

:::
